name: Hangzhou Zhongtai Cryogenic Technology Corporation
summary: Hangzhou Zhongtai Cryogenic Technology Corporation engages in the research and development, manufacturing, and service of cryogenic key equipment and plant packages in China. The company offers engineering package services, such as natural gas engineering, air separation, Syngas cryogenic separation, olefins separation, specialty gas, and chemical gas purification; EPC services; nitrogen production services; and hydrogen energy solutions, including hydrogen production, hydrogen purification, and hydrogen liquefaction.
